connector.name: Codeweaver
connector.registryDescription: Semantic code search built for AI agents. Hybrid, AST-aware, context for 166 languages.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package code-weaver. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.knitli. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CODEWEAVER_CONFIG_FILE
env.description: Specify a custom config file path for CodeWeaver. Only needed if not using the default locations.

env.description: Enable debug mode for CodeWeaver.

env.description: Specify the API key for the embedding provider, if required. Note: {', '.join([p for p in _providers_for_kind('embedding') if p.])}

env.description: Set the server host for CodeWeaver.
